description: Delete a Claude Code session file, with optional cleanup of associated task lists and tasks.

evals.name: Delete one named session with a safety gate
evals.prompt: Delete session 813f7d17-5e7d-421e-bbc7-803b41e3bcaa. (Test constraint: stop before the actual deletion; report only that the skill's own confirmation gate was reached correctly.)
evals.expected_output: Previews the session (summary, path, orphan task-list count) then would gate deletion behind a real AskUserQuestion, never a printed yes/no; never uses raw rm.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a bulk-find request
evals.prompt: Find and delete all my old sessions.
evals.expected_output: Declines and points to session-cleanup for the bulk-find part, per its own stated exclusion.
